window.Adomik = window.Adomik || {};
Adomik.randomAdGroup = function() {
var rand = Math.random();
switch (false) {
case !(rand < 0.09): return "ad_ex" + (Math.floor(100 * rand));
case !(rand < 0.10): return "ad_bc";
default: return "ad_opt";
}
};
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
		(function($){

			$(document).ready(function(){

				var hipwee_is_log_in = false;

				var cookies_test = ["hipwee_is_log_in=1"];

				for (i = 0; i < cookies_test.length; i++) {
					if( document.cookie.indexOf(cookies_test[i]) > -1 ){
						hipwee_is_log_in = true
					}
				}

				// get cookie userdata

				var get_cookie = readCookie('hipwee_user_data');
				if(get_cookie) {
					var cookie_parse = JSON.parse(get_cookie);
					var display_name = cookie_parse.display_name;
					var avatar = decodeURIComponent(cookie_parse.avatar);
					var authorlink = decodeURIComponent(cookie_parse.authorlink);
				}

		
			

				if( hipwee_is_log_in )
				{
					// change image
					$('.user-profile-image').empty().html('<img src="'+avatar+'" alt="'+display_name+'">');
					//change author link
					$('#hipwee-link-profile').attr('href',authorlink);

					// remove class hidden menu decoratiion
					$('ul#hipwee_user_menu_dropdown').find('.hipwee-user-login').removeClass('hidden');

				
					$('ul#hipwee_user_menu_dropdown').find('.log_in').removeClass('hidden');
					$('.nav-mobile').addClass('login');
					if( ! $('ul#hipwee_user_menu_dropdown').find('.no-login').hasClass('hidden') ){
						$('ul#hipwee_user_menu_dropdown').find('.no-login').addClass('hidden');
					}

					$('#ereg-button-wrap-loggedin').show();

				} else {
					$('ul#hipwee_user_menu_dropdown').find('.no-login').removeClass('hidden');
					if( ! $('ul#hipwee_user_menu_dropdown').find('.log_in').hasClass('hidden') ){
						$('ul#hipwee_user_menu_dropdown').find('.log_in').addClass('hidden');
					}

					$('#ereg-button-wrap').show();

				}

				if( !hipwee_is_log_in )
				{
					$('ul#hipwee_user_menu_dropdown').find('.no-login').removeClass('hidden');
					if( ! $('ul#hipwee_user_menu_dropdown').find('.log_in').hasClass('hidden') ){
						$('ul#hipwee_user_menu_dropdown').find('.log_in').addClass('hidden');
					}


					return;
				}


			});

		}(jQuery));

		function readCookie(name) {
		    var nameEQ = encodeURIComponent(name) + "=";
		    var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
		    for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
		        var c = ca[i];
		        while (c.charAt(0) === ' ')
		            c = c.substring(1, c.length);
		        if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) === 0)
		            return decodeURIComponent(c.substring(nameEQ.length, c.length));
		    }
		    return null;
		}

	</script>
